battle.name: 科帕尼的起義
battle.brief: 996 年，科帕尼在匈牙利王國索莫吉郡起兵反抗斯捷潘大公，西部各郡首領與農民隨之而動。斯捷潘集結王室軍隊南下平叛，起義軍在沼澤與土築寨堡之間周旋，終在撤退中被截獲，科帕尼其後被押往亞拉德處決。此役全靠複合弓騎射與重裝騎兵衝鋒分出勝負，並無攻城器上場，卡面的羅馬弩砲只作武器譜系的註腳。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰兩方都在匈牙利王國內部：一方是起義的科帕尼，他以西部外多瑙河一帶的長老級首領身分，率領索莫吉郡的武裝農民、村鎮民兵與依附於他的貴族隨從；另一方是王室，即在 975 年前後以大公身分統治的斯捷潘，他的軍隊由各郡首領的血親隨從、近衛騎士與弓箭手組成。10 世紀末的匈牙利仍帶有征服時期的部族聯盟色彩，軍隊並未完全官僚化，郡級首領各自率領本族戰士出征，鄉村設有百夫長與村鎮守備。王室的指揮系統集中於大公一人：他下令集結、自任全軍主將，再把各路隨從分編為左翼、右翼與預備隊。起義方的指揮則高度集中在科帕尼一身，他是唯一的軍事首領，起義能成也敗在他一人身上；各郡首領追隨他，是出於對其王位繼承資格的期待，而不是出於共同的制度綱領。
countriesEn: Both sides of this conflict fought inside the Kingdom of Hungary. On one side stood Koppány, acting as the senior lord of western Transdanubia, leading the armed peasants, village militias and noble followers of Somogy County. On the other stood the royal side, that is the host of Grand Prince Stephen, who had taken the grand princely title around 975; his army was drawn from the kindred levies of the county lords, the household guard and the archers. At the end of the 10th century Hungary still carried the character of a tribal confederation. Armies were not yet fully bureaucratised, each county lord led the warriors of his own kindred into the field, and villages were guarded by a hundred-man and by local levies. The royal command structure concentrated on the grand prince: he called the levy, took personal command of the whole host, and split the gathered contingents into wings and a reserve. The command of the insurgents was centred entirely on Koppány, the only military leader of the rising; the revolt rose and fell with him alone. The county lords who followed him did so out of a conviction that his claim to the succession was the stronger, not out of any shared programme.
people: 核心人物可分三組。其一是科帕尼，拉丁文獻作 Coppan、Copanus，是索莫吉郡一帶的實際統治者，頭銜相當於統治西部外多瑙河地區的長老級首領；後世地名如科帕尼村與科帕尼山，據說都留有他的名字。他的出身在編年中說法不一：西蒙·凱扎的《匈牙利人的事蹟》記他為吉薩大公的親族，《無名作者》的《匈牙利人的事蹟》則把他寫成與斯捷潘同出一母系的遠親，並由此賦予他挑戰王位的正當性。其二是斯捷潘，後世尊為聖斯捷潘一世，996 年時約二十歲上下，在父親吉薩過世後不久取得大公之位，卻尚未加冕為王，軍政大權仍靠血親隨從與各郡的支持維持。其三是站在科帕尼一方的西部各郡首領與其隨從，以及倒向王室、被編入王軍的村鎮武裝。科帕尼最後的結局也由他自己決定：被俘後他不肯認罪，於是在亞拉德的集會上被處決，死得比其他郡首領更決絕，也讓王室得以在沒有大戰的情況下結束整場反亂。
peopleEn: Three groups of people matter here. First is Koppány himself, Coppan or Copanus in the Latin sources, the de facto ruler of the Somogy region, whose title amounted to that of the senior lord of western Transdanubia. The village of Koppány and the Koppány hill are said to preserve his name. His descent is described differently in different chronicles: Simon of Kéza, writing the Gesta Hungarorum, makes him a kinsman of Duke Géza, while the anonymous author of the Gesta Hungarorum presents him as a distant relative of Stephen on the mother's side, which is what gives him a claim to the throne. Second is Stephen, István, venerated later as Saint Stephen I, about twenty years old in 996, who had taken the grand princely title shortly after his father Géza died and was not yet crowned king; his military and political authority still rested on kindred levies and on the support of the counties. Third are the western county lords and their followers who joined Koppány, together with the village levies that transferred their loyalty to the crown. The end of the affair was decided by Koppány himself: he would not acknowledge the charge against him, and so he was executed at the assembly of Arad, more stubbornly and more harshly than the other county lords, which allowed the crown to close the whole rising without a great battle.
kits: 先說卡面這件羅馬弩砲。它是共和國晚期、約公元前五十年出現的扭力弩砲：扭力束儲能，一發一具粗重弩箭，一次只能射出一發，有效射程約三百五十至四百二十公尺，用途是把守軍的拋射火力壓到攻城隊形上；羅馬人正是靠這類機械拆掉希臘的城牆。但到 996 年，這種武器早已退出歐洲戰場一千多年，中世紀文獻裡再也找不到 Scorpio 這個名字，它在此役的位置只能說是武器譜系上的一則註腳，代表「以單發重型弩箭作定點壓制」這條技術路線的源頭，而這條路線在 996 年的匈牙利並沒有實物延續。真正上陣的裝備分兩類。雙方通用的是匈牙利弓手的複合反曲弓與箭袋，角、蹄筋與木胎的結構能讓弓身在保持張力的同時回彈，精度足以在兩三百公尺外取人；配以鐵刃彎刀、長矛、戰斧、錘與小盾，構成匈牙利重裝步兵的標準配備，首領與貴族則是長矛或彎刀加鎖子甲的裝甲騎士。防禦一方靠土築台地加木柵的早期圓形土寨，圍城用撞錘、火攻與壕溝，10 世紀的匈牙利尚未普遍配備投石機。馬匹是經挑選的匈牙利重型馬，負責衝鋒、追擊與傳令；軍需靠牛拉的雙輪車隊與渡口維持。
kitsEn: Begin with the card itself, the Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered bolt thrower that appeared in the late Republic, around 50 BC. Its elastic energy was stored in a bundle of twisted sinew, it fired a single heavy bolt at a time, its effective range was roughly 350 to 420 metres, and it was used to press the missile fire of a defender onto the formations of an attacker; the Romans broke the walls of Greek cities with machines of this family. By 996, however, the weapon had been out of use in Europe for more than a millennium and the name Scorpio no longer appears anywhere in medieval sources, so its place in this campaign can only be a note in the lineage of weapons, marking the source of the idea of single-shot heavy bolt artillery, an idea that had no living continuation in Hungary in 996. The equipment actually in the field fell into two groups. Common to both sides were the composite reflex bows and quivers of the Hungarian archers, built of horn, sinew and wood so that the limbs could store and release the draw smoothly enough to shoot accurately at two or three hundred metres; with iron-edged sabres, spears, axes, maces and small shields they formed the standard kit of the Hungarian heavy infantry, while chiefs and nobles appear as armoured lance or sabre horsemen. The defensive side relied on early ring forts of earth platforms and timber palisade, attacked with rams, fire and ditching; the Hungarians of the 10th century did not yet field stone-throwing engines in any general way. Horses were the selected heavy Hungarian breeds used for the charge, pursuit and dispatch, and supply was kept moving by ox-drawn two-wheeled wagons and by the crossings.
tactics: 戰術空間在索莫吉郡、巴拉頓湖北岸與外多瑙河西部一帶：西奧河與多瑙河支流之間夾著大片沼澤、濕地與丘陵農地，村莊密集而道路泥濘。起義方採取的是固守鄉土、避免會戰的思路，武裝農民熟悉地形，能在田埂、樹林與村屋之間分散移動，遇王室騎兵來襲便退入土寨或寺院據點，避開正面交鋒；科帕尼則把隨從集中在自己的寨堡周圍，等候援軍與談判時機。王室方的戰術正好相反，斯捷潘不急於攻堅，而是以快速行軍切斷各郡首領之間的聯繫，逼迫科帕尼離開掩體出來決戰；軍隊分縱隊沿湖岸與河谷推進，騎兵擔任先鋒與側翼迂回，弓箭手在接觸前列陣放箭，步兵近戰以長矛、斧與錘解決。補給線是王室軍隊最脆弱的一環，糧秣靠牛車與馬車沿少數可行車的道路運往營地，遇雨季或沼澤路段就必須改道或搭浮橋，拖慢全軍速度。最後的結局並非在戰場上分出，而是靠追擊與生擒完成：科帕尼在退入自己仍能控制的區域時被王室騎兵截住並俘虜，其餘起義者失去首領後各自散去。整場衝突沒有一次大規模攻城，攻城器與重型機械完全沒有出現在這段歷史裡。
tacticsEn: The theatre of operations was Somogy County, the northern shore of Lake Balaton and western Transdanubia: a country of marshes, wet meadows and hill farms threaded by the Sió and the tributaries of the Danube, with dense villages and muddy roads. The insurgents fought the way local irregulars do. The armed peasants knew the ground and could disperse among field paths, woods and farmsteads, falling back into earth forts or church strongholds rather than meeting a royal charge, while Koppány concentrated his followers around his own fort and waited for reinforcement or for a negotiated settlement. The royal plan was the opposite, because Stephen was in no hurry to besiege anyone: he moved fast enough to cut the county lords off from one another and force Koppány out of cover and into open ground. The host marched in columns along the lakeshore and the river valleys, cavalry leading and covering the flanks, archers formed up to shoot before contact, and the infantry closed with spear, axe and mace. Supply was the weakest link in the royal army: rations and baggage moved along the few roads passable for wagons, and rain or a marshy section meant detours or improvised bridges, slowing the whole host. The revolt was not broken in a set-piece battle but by pursuit and seizure. Koppány was intercepted by royal horse while withdrawing into the area he still controlled, and the rest of the insurgents scattered once they had lost their leader. Not one sizeable siege was fought, and no siege engine or heavy engine appears anywhere in the record.
data: 可用的數字很有限，這是這場戰爭在史料上的特點。年代最確定：叛亂始於 996 年，鎮壓在 996 年內完成，科帕尼的處決繫於 997 年在亞拉德召開的集會，亞拉德即今日羅馬尼亞的亞拉德，約在北緯 46.18 度、東經 20.88 度。路程方面，從索莫吉郡的科帕尼一帶到亞拉德，按當時道路計約四百至五百公里，隊伍每日行進里程有限，押送需時數週，途中示眾的羞辱也就發生在這段路上。戰區縱深：索莫吉郡南北約一百公里，橫跨西奧河至巴拉頓湖北岸，起義方能同時威脅的據點數以十計。兵力上所有中世紀來源都沒有留下雙方人數的數字，較穩妥的推算是兩軍作戰人員當在數千人至萬餘人之間，遠超平時郡級隨從的規模，但全國人口在 10 世紀末估計僅數十萬，能被徵召的上限本來就低。城防方面，科帕尼的寨堡是土築台地加木柵的早期型制，無城磚、無塔樓群，壕溝簡陋。損失沒有任何數字記載，可以確定的只是科帕尼一人被殺、西部支持者因失去首領而瓦解，隨後數年內西部各郡進行了密集的城堡改建。起義的確切月份在中世紀編年中無載，按斯捷潘在 996 年夏秋之間集結西部軍隊、次年亞拉德集會處決的推算，戰役當置於 996 年 6 月至 9 月，卡面取 6 月為代表月份。
dataEn: The numbers available are thin, and that is itself a feature of the evidence. The dates are the firmest points: the revolt began in 996, was crushed within that year, and the execution of Koppány is tied to the assembly of Arad in 997, at modern Arad in Romania, roughly 46.18 degrees north and 20.88 degrees east. As for distance, from the Koppány area of Somogy to Arad is some 400 to 500 kilometres by the roads of the time; the daily march of a column was short, so the escort took weeks, and the public humiliation of the prisoner happened along that road. The operational depth of the theatre was about a hundred kilometres north to south, from the Sió to the northern shore of Lake Balaton, with the insurgent strongpoints numbering in the tens. On strength, no medieval source gives a figure for either army; the defensible estimate is that the men under arms on both sides ran to several thousand, perhaps as many as ten thousand, far above the size of ordinary county levies, though the population of the whole kingdom in the late 10th century was only in the hundreds of thousands, which capped what could be raised in the first place. On fortifications, Koppány's stronghold was an early earth-and-timber enclosure with no masonry facing, no towers and a modest ditch. No casualty figures survive at all: what is certain is that Koppány was killed, that his western support collapsed for want of a leader, and that the castle-building in the western counties was intensified in the years that followed. The exact month of the outbreak is not recorded by any medieval chronicler; the campaign is placed in the summer and autumn of 996 ahead of the assembly at Arad in the following year, and the card uses June as its representative month.
cause: 起義的成因有三層。最內在的一層是權力結構：斯捷潘執政後把征服時期各首領的私人武裝逐步收編為王室的郡制編制，重新分配土地與服役義務，並把羅馬禮儀與教會稅收落到地方，什一稅的開徵直接侵蝕了科帕尼一類地方首領的經濟基礎與人身依附關係。第二層是王位繼承權的模糊：吉薩大公約在 975 年前後去世，年幼的斯捷潘即位缺乏成熟程序，而編年把科帕尼寫成吉薩的親族，等於向天下宣告另有一個血統資格更硬的人選；科帕尼本人未必打算推翻現有政體，但他作為西部長老的身分，使誰該繼承成為一個可以用武器回答的問題。第三層是地理與社會條件：外多瑙河西部剛完成征服定居不久，羅馬教會與教區網絡正在鋪開，舊有的部族首領與地方祭司傳統尚未被完全吸收，農民對什一稅與城堡服役義務的不滿，為起義提供了人望與人數。綜合而言，這並非純粹的農民暴動，而是一場以一位王位競爭者為核心、由不滿新秩序的地方首領與受動員的農民共同構成的反亂；農民是附從，貴族才是主角。
causeEn: Three layers lie behind the rising. The innermost is structural: once Stephen was in power he began absorbing the private armed followings of the conquest-era chieftains into royal county organisation, redistributed land and service obligations, and pushed Roman liturgy and church taxation down into the localities, where the collecting of the tithe cut directly into the economic base and the personal dependence on which men like Koppány lived. The second layer is the vagueness of the succession. Géza died around 975, and the young Stephen's accession was not settled by any mature procedure, while the chronicles make Koppány a kinsman of Géza, effectively announcing to the world a rival with the better blood claim. Koppány may not have intended to overthrow the existing order at all, but as a senior lord of the west his position turned the question of who should succeed into one that could be answered with weapons. The third layer is geography and social strain: western Transdanubia had only just been settled by the conquest, the Roman church and its network of parishes were spreading, the older tribal and priestly traditions had not yet been absorbed, and resentment of tithes and of castle service gave the rising both numbers and popularity. Taken together, this was not a pure peasant rising but a rebellion built around one claimant to the throne, with the peasantry in tow and the nobility in the lead.
impact: 這場反亂的結果，長遠看比戰場本身更重要。征討結束後，斯捷潘把西部重建成王國的核心防線：在索莫吉與外多瑙河沿岸密集修築或改築城堡，把服役義務與土地授予綁定，確立了後來延續數百年的城堡臣僕體系；郡級官僚、法官與教區同時落實，羅馬禮儀在西部扎根，並與經由斯拉夫諸地與保加利亞傳入的拜占庭禮儀相互競爭。對外，匈牙利在 1000 年 12 月於費爾維奧完成加冕、確立與西方拉丁教會平行的王國身份，而這一轉折所需的財政、軍事與教會基礎，正是平定科帕尼之後才握有的。當時的反響也很直接：西部若干貴族被沒收土地，忠于王室的村鎮首領獲得職位與田產作為酬庸，舊有的部族首領體制就此終結，匈牙利王國從部族聯盟過渡到以王權與城堡為骨架的國家。科帕尼的名字沒有從記憶中消失：地方地名、編年史的記錄，以及後世把這次叛亂視為王權成熟的敘述，都讓他成為匈牙利中世紀史上帶有反叛象徵意味的名字。
impactEn: In the long run the consequences matter more than the fighting. Once the rising was suppressed, Stephen turned the west into the core defensive belt of the kingdom: forts were raised or rebuilt in dense chains along Somogy and the Transdanubian coast, service was tied to grants of land, and the castle-service system endured for centuries. County officials, judges and dioceses were established at the same time, and the Roman rite took root in the west in competition with the Byzantine rite arriving through the Slavic lands and Bulgaria. Abroad, the coronation of December 1000 at Fehérvár and the standing of the kingdom alongside the Latin church of the West rested on a military, fiscal and ecclesiastical base that existed only because Koppány had been defeated. The immediate reaction was equally concrete: land confiscations in the west, offices and holdings handed out to the village leaders who had stayed loyal, and the end of the old tribal aristocracy. Hungary passed from tribal confederation to a state built on royal power and castles. Koppány's name did not vanish from memory: it survives in place-names, in the chronicles, and in the later reading of this revolt as the moment when royal authority came of age.
result: 結局是王室完勝。起義軍在索莫吉郡一帶被擊潰，參與的各郡首領或被收編、或失去土地；科帕尼本人在退向自己仍能控制的區域時被王室軍隊截獲，隨後被押往亞拉德，傳說與編年記載他被反縛在馬尾上拖行上路，抵達亞拉德後在集會上以叛亂者的身分被處決，有編年稱其首級被送往各地示眾，也有記載略去這一細節。科帕尼控制的寨堡與莊園隨之被王室接收，西部各郡改由王室直接派員管治，並開始修築一系列新城堡；分封與封賞名單裡，忠于斯捷潘的地方首領佔了多數。從全局看，996 年的科帕尼起義是匈牙利王國建立初期最清楚的一次內戰紀錄：它終結了征服時期殘留的部族貴族政治，證明大公可以在沒有常備軍、沒有成熟官僚體系的情況下，靠血親隨從與郡級動員平定挑戰，並為 997 年之後的國家整頓、1000 至 1001 年的加冕與拉丁化鋪平了道路。
resultEn: The outcome was a royal victory. The insurgents were beaten in Somogy County; the county lords who had joined them were either taken into royal service or stripped of their land. Koppány himself was intercepted by royal troops while withdrawing towards the area he still held, and was carried off to Arad: the chronicles and later tradition have him bound to a horse's tail and dragged along the road, and he was put to death there at the assembly as a rebel. Some accounts add that his head was sent out to be displayed, others pass over the detail. His forts and estates passed to the crown, the western counties were placed under direct royal administration, and a chain of new castles was begun; in the distribution of honours and grants the loyal village and county leaders of the royal side took the larger share. Taken as a whole, the rising of Koppány in 996 is the clearest record of an internal war in the early Kingdom of Hungary. It ended the residual politics of the tribal nobility, and it showed that a grand prince could defeat a challenge without a standing army or a settled bureaucracy, relying on kindred levies and county mobilisation, while clearing the way for the reform of the state after 997 and for the coronation and Latinisation of 1000 to 1001.
